title: Demo: list every catalog entry
description: Self-referential: lists every demo in the catalog. Confirms the JsonDemoCatalog reader sees the on-disk specs. Read-only; no infra required.

observe.what: table of demos with id · title · step count

whatProves: JsonDemoCatalog discovers + lists every <id>.json spec under docs/demos/, NEXUS_DEMOS_PATH, or the cwd-relative path.
